caption:
Toto coaches junior athletics, and a few of the kids say their heels hurt after training.

In growing kids, the back of the heel bone is still developing, so lots of running and jumping can make it sore. This is often called Sever's disease, and it usually settles over time with load adjusted rather than stopping sport altogether.

Hybi's tips: cut back running and jumping on sore days, calf stretch for 30 seconds 2–3 times, and ice for 10 minutes after sport.

Pain at rest or at night, swelling, or a limp that persists are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🏃
